How easily people or places are harmed by a hazard (e.g. poverty, poor housing, living on a flood plain).

front: When and where did Cyclone Idai strike Zimbabwe?
back: March 2019, mainly Chimanimani and Chipinge in Manicaland.

front: Which body coordinates disaster management in Zimbabwe?
Name the three types of hazard with an example of each.
back: Natural (flood, drought), biological (cholera, fall armyworm), man-made (mine collapse, road accident).

front: Name the four stages of the disaster management cycle.
Why do floods often lead to disease?
back: Toilets and wells are flooded, so drinking water is contaminated and diseases such as cholera spread.
